records.source: Starting Cabins: Start with 1-{0} cabins already in place, allowing your friends to join immediately. Alternatively, you can select "None" and build the cabins yourself (via Robin).^^Cabin Layout: If you decide to start your farm with pre-existing cabins, you can choose between two layout styles: "Nearby" places all cabins near the main farmhouse, encouraging a communal farming style. "Separate" places the cabins far apart, allowing more room for independence.^^Profit Margin: Adjusts the profit margin (money you earn) on goods you sell. 'Normal' is the original Stardew Valley experience. More experienced and/or larger groups may wish to decrease the margin.
records.translation: 初始小屋：遊戲開始時已有1-{0}間小屋，讓朋友能立刻加入。你也可以選擇「無」，再透過羅賓自行建造小屋。^^小屋配置：如果你決定讓農場一開始就有小屋，可以選擇兩種配置方式。「鄰近」會把所有小屋放在主農舍附近，適合共同經營農場；「分散」則讓小屋彼此相隔較遠，提供更多獨立發展空間。^^利潤率：調整你出售商品時可獲得的利潤。「標準」就是原本的星露谷遊戲體驗。經驗較豐富和/或人數較多的團體可以考慮降低利潤率。

records.source: {0} has removed an ancient magi-seal of protection in the Skull Cavern. Tonight, powerful monsters will ascend from the deep...
records.translation: {0}解除了骷髏洞穴裡一道古老的魔法防護封印。今晚，強大的怪物將從深處湧上……

records.source: {0} has restored an ancient magi-seal of protection in the Skull Cavern. Tomorrow, it will return to normal...
records.translation: {0}恢復了骷髏洞穴裡一道古老的魔法防護封印。明天，骷髏洞穴將恢復正常……

records.source: First, choose your appearance and farm type. When you're done, tap the check mark button to start playing.
records.translation: 首先，選擇你的外觀和農場類型。完成後，點一下打勾按鈕開始遊戲。

records.source: Good morning! Remember to head back to the farmhouse to sleep and save your game later on.
records.translation: 早安！晚點別忘了回農舍睡覺並儲存遊戲。

records.source: New quests are shown in the Journal. Tap on a quest to take a closer look - there's useful information there!
records.translation: 新任務會顯示在日誌中。點一下任務仔細查看，裡面有實用的資訊！

records.source: Once you've finished watering, feel free to explore Pelican Town and meet your new neighbors!
records.translation: 澆完水後，就去探索鵜鶘鎮，認識你的新鄰居吧！

records.source: The Inventory shows the items you're holding. You can drag them to rearrange, or to the trash to destroy them.
records.translation: 物品欄會顯示你持有的物品。你可以拖曳物品來重新排列，或拖到垃圾桶將其銷毀。

records.source: This page shows your skills - you can improve your skills by using tools, foraging, fishing and fighting.
records.translation: 這個頁面會顯示你的技能。使用工具、採集、釣魚和戰鬥都能提升技能。

records.source: The Social page tells you about your relationships with the people you meet.
records.translation: 社交頁面會告訴你和遇見的人關係如何。

records.source: This is where you can craft new items from the things you collect and grow. You will discover new crafting recipes throughout the game.
records.translation: 你可以在這裡用採集或種植所得的材料製作新物品。遊戲過程中還會發現新的製作配方。

records.source: Slide your finger over the map to explore Pelican Town and its surroundings.
records.translation: 在地圖上滑動手指，探索鵜鶘鎮及其周邊地區。

records.source: The Collections page keeps track of what you've shipped, fished, mined, cooked or discovered.
records.translation: 收藏頁面會記錄你出貨、釣獲、開採、烹煮或發現過的事物。

records.source: In stores, tap on the counter in front of the shopkeeper to buy or sell goods.
records.translation: 在商店裡，點一下店主面前的櫃檯即可買賣商品。

records.source: We need some seeds to plant... did you miss something back in the farmhouse?
records.translation: 我們需要一些種子來種植……你是不是漏拿了農舍裡的東西？

records.source: Are you sure you want to exit and lose any progress since the start of this game day?
records.translation: 確定要退出，並失去本遊戲日開始以來的所有進度嗎？

records.source: You can choose between auto and manual attack modes on the game options screen.
records.translation: 你可以在遊戲選項畫面中選擇自動或手動攻擊模式。

records.source: This version of Stardew Valley has been created specifically for demonstration purposes.
records.translation: 此版本的星露谷是專為展示用途而製作。

records.source:
Stardew Valley needs to perform a one time copy of your farms to a new location for the 1.5 update of the game.

In the following screen please select the `StardewValley` folder and tap 'Use this folder'.
records.translation:
為了更新至遊戲1.5版，星露谷需要將你的農場一次性複製到新位置。

請在接下來的畫面中選擇`StardewValley`資料夾，然後點一下「使用這個資料夾」。
